skill.summary: Checks API health and uptime. Monitors endpoints and validates responses. Triggers: check api status, api health, monitor uptime.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the API status checker skill.
- Monitors API health and uptime by testing endpoints and validating responses.
- Supports triggers such as “check api status”, “api health”, and “monitor uptime”.
- Provides health status based on response code and response time.
- Includes configurable alert thresholds for slow, degraded, or failing APIs.
